name: guiguiyan930-source/game-ui-design-workflow
summary: 据项目介绍，这套 Cursor Agent Skills 工作流可生成游戏界面原型、切换视觉风格、将设计延展到新页面，并将页面拆分为组件。它通过 Spec-Kit 文档、视觉契约和资源清单协调多页面设计。

The project describes a Cursor Agent Skills workflow for generating game UI prototypes, switching visual styles, extending designs to new screens, and breaking screens into components. It uses Spec-Kit documents, visual contracts, and asset inventories to coordinate design decisions across screens.
